narrationTexts: Confirmed: only `order totals` fails, exactly where tax and discount both are non-zero. The bug's in [src/pricing.js:41](src/pricing.js:41) — tax is computed on the pre-discount `cents` instead of the discounted amount.
finalText:
**Fixed. All 625 tests pass.**

`orderTotal` in [src/pricing.js:41](src/pricing.js:41) taxed the pre-discount amount instead of the discounted one. Changed it to tax `discounted` instead of `cents`.

Nothing else needs attention.
